title: ID0408546-DC/Si-D/IT [MP / R9 170002644] Start Charging Issue
description:
Reported issue:  Unstable OCPP Connection
Solution: Continue discussion on case #0409748

additional_info.subject: Note created on 2/21/2025 4:39:00 PM UTC by Luigi Iodice [contact:1fd59796-8cbb-ef11-b8e8-6045bddccb26]
Case Notes
additional_info.body:
Hello, the charge has an issue: in our backend we see that every minute the CU send a diagnostic message ("CU up again"). In addition, a consumer tried to charge 11 times from 4:04PM to 4:14PM (Italian Time Zone), 10 of them were not authorized by the CU, 1 authorized, but the linked recharge was pending for more than 1 hour and closed by us from remote (0 kWh).
Could you check if the CU is in health?
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74
OCPP Backend Connection: No

additional_info.subject: ID0408546-DC/Si-D/IT [MP / R9 170002644] Start Charging Issue CRM:00251000488
additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi Iodice,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Reetesh
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 170002644
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
JjxZSo
Problem Description
: Start Charging Issue on 21/Feb 2024 between 16:00 - 16:14 CET
At first I will apologies for not responding within 4 hours of creation of the ticket, the issue is caused by duplicate Assets in our system. The Asset “
MP / R9 170002644” was having duplicate entries and while creation of ticket, show how you selected the assets which was not linked to the service contract and hence the SLA was not reflecting at our end, thus causing delay in prioritizing your case.
I have fixed the issue for this asset and will also check the other assets for such errors.
Now, coming to the technical explanation of failed start charging at the mentioned time, upon checking the logs for this charger I could see loads of connection and disconnection between charger and the server. The server was giving error 404, hence charger was closing the websocket and trying to reconnect after 30 sec. see below (
The time mentioned in the logs are UTC time
)
2025-02-21T15:00:22.098753+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: Connecting to OCPP-Central-System "ws://cu.mindcharge-nttdata.com:60500/ocpp1.6//170002644
2025-02-21T15:00:27.139504+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP-Central-System connection error: Unexpected server response: 404
Later charger rebooted the modem to establise the connection
2025-02-21 15:03:27.655,"2025-02-21T15:03:27.321312+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - router is mobile disconnected, router reset initiated"
JjxZSo,2025-02-21 15:03:27.655,"2025-02-21T15:03:27.322095+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - router is disconnected, performing actions..."
at 15:09 we could see first RemoteStartTransaction  from the user, which was accepted
JjxZSo,2025-02-21 15:09:28.232,"2025-02-21T15:09:27.803203+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP: Received command: RemoteStartTransaction (30826989) - {""connectorId"":2,""idTag"":""IT-BEC-CT9I0TDN8-I""}"
JjxZSo,2025-02-21 15:09:28.232,"2025-02-21T15:09:27.809461+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP: Send result: RemoteStartTransaction (30826989) - {""status"":""Accepted""}"
however, immeditaley the charger was offline,
JjxZSo,2025-02-21 15:09:53.298,2025-02-21T15:09:52.822028+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP connection:
OFFLINE
JjxZSo,2025-02-21 15:09:53.298,2025-02-21T15:09:52.822256+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP reconnect to ws://cu.mindcharge-nttdata.com:60500/ocpp1.6/ in 30 seconds
And this caused the session to fail.
The connection between charger and the backend was not stable for a long time. and also, at present I can see few connections drop see below:
05:11:36 GMT
2025-02-22, 05:11:30
2025-02-22T05:11:30.784952+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: Connecting to OCPP-Central-System "ws://cu.mindcharge-nttdata.com:60500/ocpp1.6//170002644"
Sat, 22 Feb 2025 05:11:36 GMT
2025-02-22, 05:11:35
2025-02-22T05:11:35.826753+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP connection: OFFLINE
Sat, 22 Feb 2025 05:11:36 GMT
2025-02-22, 05:11:35
2025-02-22T05:11:35.828605+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP-Central-System connection error: Unexpected server response: 404

2025-02-22, 05:11:35
2025-02-22T05:11:35.830224+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP connection: OFFLINE
Sat, 22 Feb 2025 05:12:01 GMT
2025-02-22, 05:12:00
2025-02-22T05:12:00.785294+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: Connecting to OCPP-Central-System "ws://cu.mindcharge-nttdata.com:60500/ocpp1.6//170002644"
Sat, 22 Feb 2025 05:12:01 GMT
2025-02-22, 05:12:00
2025-02-22T05:12:00.857959+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0c665299a260[737]: OCPP-Central-System connection established
Can you please check the at the backend why the websocket is getting frequently disconnected with the charger.?
If required, we will ask the field service team to check and inspect the SIM card and/or router.
Additional information, this charger has the SIM and Wired connection (Wired as Failover enabled), one of the reason for the connection failure can be No -Internet on Wired.
Can you also check the wired internet connectivity on this site?
For now I have disabled the Failover and forced Ethernet for connection, let's observe it for a day to see if this brings stability to the conenction or not.
For future reference, your case number is
0408546
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
